speaker: Tracy
text: Hello and welcome to 6 Minute English from TTB Learning English. I'm Tracy.

speaker: Brian
text: And I'm Brian.

speaker: Tracy
text: Today we're talking about something quite modern... vibe coding.

speaker: Brian
text: Ah yes... the internet's favourite new phrase.

speaker: Tracy
text: Honestly, Brian, when I first heard it... I thought it sounded musical.

speaker: Brian
text: Same here. I imagined someone coding while listening to jazz.

speaker: Tracy
text: Well... some people probably do that too.

speaker: Brian
text: True. But vibe coding is actually about using AI tools to help people write software.

speaker: Tracy
text: And sometimes people barely understand the code they're creating.

speaker: Brian
text: Which is... slightly terrifying.

speaker: Tracy
text: Or exciting. Depends who you ask.

speaker: Brian
text: Good point.

speaker: Tracy
text: So Brian... quick question before we start.

speaker: Brian
text: Go on then.

speaker: Tracy
text: Which programming language was created first?

speaker: Brian
text: Oh no... a tech quiz.

speaker: Tracy
text: Yes. Was it... A: Python, B: Java, or C: Fortran?

speaker: Brian
text: Hmm...

speaker: Tracy
text: Take your time.

speaker: Brian
text: Well... I know Python feels old now.

speaker: Tracy
text: It does.

speaker: Brian
text: But Java also sounds ancient.

speaker: Tracy
text: You sound very scientific.

speaker: Brian
text: Thank you. I try.

speaker: Brian
text: Uh... I'll say C: Fortran.

speaker: Tracy
text: Interesting.

speaker: Brian
text: Which usually means I'm wrong.

speaker: Tracy
text: We'll find out later in the programme.

speaker: Brian
text: Right then... vibe coding.

text: So, Brian, have you ever used AI to write code?
